chunks: And from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
The walking of a Muslim in fulfilling the need of a fellow Muslim is better than seventy circumambulations of the Sacred House.
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual reward for helping a Muslim with their needs according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) elevates the practical act of fulfilling a believer's need above the ritualistic devotion of seventy circumambulations (tawaf), emphasizing that social utility holds immense spiritual weight in Shia ethics. This hadith, recorded in *Kitab al-Mumin*, underscores the principle that relieving distress is a direct manifestation of faith, often cited by scholars to balance ritual piety with communal responsibility.

en.muhajir-b-ali: 130. It has been reported that Abu 'Abd Allah (a.s) said:
The walking of a Muslim in fulfilling the need of a fellow Muslim is better than seventy circumambulations of the Sacred House (i.e. Ka'bah).
